A language model is trained exclusively on human-verified mathematical solutions and fine-tuned using a reward signal derived from human preference rankings of its outputs. Compared to a base language model, what specific kind of model results when this human-feedback-driven training loop is applied to steer the model away from narrative responses and toward precise, correct numerical answers?
questions.explanation: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is a fine-tuning technique where human evaluators rank model outputs to train a reward model, which then guides the language model toward preferred behaviors. When this feedback loop is applied using human-verified mathematical solutions as training data, the resulting RLHF-enhanced model learns to prioritize arithmetic correctness over verbose, narrative-style answers. This alignment approach underpins systems like InstructGPT and is a cornerstone of modern LLM alignment research.
